cabin.berth_omission_reason: The authored narrow aft cuddy cannot support a freestanding 0.60 × 1.80 m adult berth while retaining its 0.65 m aisle, supported sole and real descending companion. The read source establishes a modest cuddy but no fixed berth arrangement for this game family; bench and locker are inferred without extending the cabin into the battery.
